summary: Jupiter over the natal Moon's own sign is an unfavourable transit in the classical texts: displacement from home, heavy spending, loss of money and judgment, and quarrels.
common_outcomes: heavy expenses and loss of wealth
rare_outcomes: [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death], with loss of position and wealth (Phaladeepika 26.33: Jupiter in the 1st, 8th or 12th from the Moon)

lagna_or_context_notes: Phaladeepika 26.1: transits are judged from the Moon's sign. Raman: the birth chart, the running dasa/bhukti and ashtakavarga modify transit results, and Jupiter's sign-to-sign transit gives the yearly results. P.V.R. Narasimha Rao: a stationary Jupiter acts strongly on natal points it touches, well from kendras/trikonas of the lagna and badly from dusthanas, and his examples weigh whether Jupiter is a functional benefic in that chart.
